subject: Compliance workbasket: prioritization and owners for MedBridge requests
messages:
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@medbridge-health.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: MedBridge Security <security@medbridge-health.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for offering to help consolidate our open compliance asks. Attached is a spreadsheet (MedBridge-SIG-questions.xlsx) that includes a mix of document requests and product feature clarifications: retention/archival windows, ability to disable indexing for a customer subset, KMS/BYOK options, SSO audit log export formats, and the format of your audit event stream.

High-level asks from our side:
- A short note on whether retention is configurable per-tenant and what the minimum/maximum windows are.
- Whether we can supply our own keys (BYOK) and a timeline for an on-prem HSM integration (if applicable).
- A sample of the audit event schema and whether it includes user agent/region fields.
- How SSO provisioning actions appear in logs and whether they can be exported to our SIEM as a daily bundle.

We have an internal deadline of Sep 25 to file the SOC readiness artifacts. Can you let me know who at Redwood can own each line and the rough ETA? If easier, happy to jump on a short call this week.

Best,
Alice
IT Compliance Lead
MedBridge Health
-- Attachment: MedBridge-SIG-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Tan <alice.tan@medbridge-health.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review

Thanks Alice — forwarding to the cross-functional workstream.

Team, please review the attached spreadsheet and flag which items are product work versus documentation/evidence we can provide today. Priority: items that block MedBridge's Sep 25 SOC package.

Proposed triage buckets (quick):
1) Evidence we can hand off (logs, existing runbooks) — target: 3 business days
2) Low-effort console/UX changes (export format toggles, per-tenant retention toggle) — target: 2 sprints
3) Mid/large product work (BYOK full HSM flow, event-stream schema additions) — planning/estimates needed

Can each of you add a one-line owner + ETA by EOD Wed? I can then share the prioritized workbasket with MedBridge.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Product Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review

Priya — quick notes after a scan of the sheet:

- Retention per-tenant: current platform supports tenant-level retention windows via config; default 90 days, min 7 days, max 7 years. We can produce a short doc + example API call. Owner: jonas_weber — ETA: 2 business days to produce docs and sample payloads.

- Audit event schema: we already emit timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, user_agent. Missing region — we can add geo lookup at ingest but that's a 1-sprint feature and will change event payload. For SOC package we can provide the current schema and a short note on planned schema extension. Owner: jonas_weber — ETA: current schema doc in 3 business days; geo field: product backlogged (1 sprint).

- SSO provisioning bundles: we have a daily export for auth events; need to confirm if it contains provisioning metadata (it currently includes SAML assertion IDs). Owner: grace_oconnor to confirm with infra — ETA: EOD Thu.

I'll attach the quick snippet to the Drive folder once done.

- BYOK / KMS: full BYOK with customer-supplied HSM (on-prem) is non-trivial. We do have KMS integration for cloud provider keys (AWS/GCP) and a soft-BYOK path (customer-managed keys via our KMS connector). For on-prem HSM we need a scoped design doc and security review. Owner: karthik_iyer for technical assessment — ETA: preliminary impact note in 1 week.

Jonas
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review

Thanks — small additions from Product/Console side:

- Per-tenant retention UI: low lift. We can expose a retention dropdown on the tenant settings page and a REST endpoint for infra to call. Dev estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 QA day. Owner: grace_oconnor — ETA: PR in 10 business days.

- Audit export formats: we support JSONL and CSV exports today. If MedBridge needs a particular field ordering or a compressed bundle (gz) for SIEM ingestion, that's a small enhancement (1-2 dev days). Can you ask Alice for the preferred format?

- For the geo field, as Jonas noted, adding geo at ingest is a product + infra change but we can offer a short-term mapping on ingest logs (post-processing) as a stopgap.

On the MedBridge deadline: we should aim to provide current evidence + explicit notes about planned changes. That generally satisfies SOC readiness timelines as long as we commit to timelines for mid/large items.

— Grace
Product Manager, Observability
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review

Adding procurement/contract context:

- MedBridge currently has a POC-level contract. If we need to commit to BYOK/HSM support in the short term, we should confirm commercial willingness to pay for an engineering integration fee and an ongoing support surcharge. I can loop in legal if MedBridge wants language that guarantees a migration plan or SLAs around key handling.

- DocuSign envelope for the SOW addendum: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-12345 (placeholder). Please don't sign anything until we have scope and a rough estimate.

Owner: ben_carter for commercial follow-up — ETA: I'll propose SOW language by Sep 20 and ping Alice for cost acceptance.

-Ben
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@medbridge-health.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial list of compliance asks ahead of Oct review — prioritized workbasket

Alice / team — quick summary and owners (sending prioritized CSV as attachment):

Decisions and next steps:
1) Evidence pack (logs + schema): Jonas will deliver current audit schema and sample logs by Tue 2028-09-17. ACTION: jonas_weber
2) Retention per-tenant docs + API example: Jonas to provide docs in 2 business days; Grace to schedule a UI task for the retention dropdown (ETA PR in ~10 business days). ACTION: jonas_weber, grace_oconnor
3) SSO provisioning export: Grace to confirm if provisioning metadata is in the daily export and provide a sample bundle by Thu EOD (2028-09-14). ACTION: grace_oconnor
4) BYOK / HSM: Kar thik to scope technical requirements and security review steps; estimate due 2028-09-21. Commercial (Ben) will prepare SOW language and cost estimate by Sep 20. ACTION: karthik_iyer, ben_carter
5) Procurement: Ben will not sign any DocuSign SOW until scoping and estimate are agreed. ACTION: ben_carter

Please review; if no objections I will share this prioritized workbasket with MedBridge this afternoon.

Attachments: compliance-workbasket.csv (spreadsheet of triaged items and owners)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn.

Priya
Senior Product Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference
